# Changing your plan (article changing-your-plan)

You can move between Free, Pro and Team at any time.

## Upgrading

An upgrade takes effect straight away, and the new plan's limits apply at
once. The first invoice for the new plan is dated the day you upgrade.

## Downgrading

A downgrade also takes effect straight away. If you now have more notebooks
than the new plan allows, nothing is deleted: the extra notebooks become
read-only until you remove some or upgrade again.

A downgrade does not refund the old plan on its own. See the refund policy for
what can be refunded, and ask for it when you downgrade.

# Plans and pricing (article plans-and-pricing)

Acme Notes has three plans.

## Free

For trying Acme Notes out. Up to 3 notebooks, 100 MB of storage and one
member. No invoices, because there is nothing to pay.

## Pro

For one person who writes a lot. Unlimited notebooks, 10 GB of storage,
version history and offline access. Pro costs $12.00 a month, billed monthly.

## Team

For groups working in shared notebooks. Everything in Pro, plus shared
notebooks, admin controls and 50 GB of storage per seat. Team costs
$120.00 per seat a year, billed annually for every seat on the account.
